name: Tosantos (Spain)
description: Red field with a white isosceles triangle from the hoist to the middle of the fly, itself charged with a green triangle from the hoist to the centre bearing a white eradicated tree.
history: The flag is rectangular of proportions 2:3, red, charged with a white isosceles triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the midpoint of the fly, itself charged with a green triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the centre of the flag.

features.role: isosceles triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the middle of the fly
triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre
eradicated tree on the green triangle
